snippet.title: Super Sexy Swiss - Trailer
snippet.description:
Silly three-way ride through a quirky Sexy Switzerland

P1 steers the wheel to avoid volcanoes, unicorns and pirate ships, P2 massages the heart and P3 sweeps the blood off the windscreen - everyone using the same gaming device.
What's the mission of the S.S.S.C.F.A.T.T. - Super Sexy Swiss Cardio Frenetic Ambulance Transplant Team?

To deliver a living heart along with some MASSIVE FUN!

http://supersexyswiss.jarnik.com/

Now released no OUYA, coming to Android and PC.
